clue.text: Before head of committee, recommend moving folder for infant (9)

clue.text: Group of people fixed part of match (3)

blocks.note: a social circle, as in the jet-setters
fixed in place, as a time or price can be
a tennis match is divided into these

explanation.surface: A gang has rigged a game.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a triple definition: 'fixed' is a third meaning, which makes the surface read as match-fixing.
explanation.definitionFit: Three senses of one short word: a social circle, something fixed, and a unit of a tennis match.

clue.text: Fellows receiving unknown backing for church meeting (5)

indicators.note: To receive is to take in, so the fellows take the unknown inside.
Backing means moving backwards, so the result is read in reverse.

blocks.note: algebra's unknown; goes in after DON

explanation.surface: College fellows get anonymous support for a church assembly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Backing' reads as support; here it turns the letters round.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: an assembly of clergy, and often laity, governing a church.

clue.text: Put clothes back on for satisfaction (7)

blocks.note: to clothe oneself again: 'again' prefix plus 'clothe'
in the legal sense: amends for a wrong

explanation.surface: Getting dressed again feels satisfying.
explanation.walkthrough: Satisfaction here is the old sense of compensation, as when a duellist demanded satisfaction.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: dressing again, and the remedy owed for a grievance.

clue.text: Like some avenues I entered, doubtful about length (4-5)

indicators.note: Doubtful means uncertain, so the letters are in no settled order.
About means surrounding, so the anagram goes round the L.

blocks.note: standard abbreviation; sits inside the anagram

explanation.surface: Someone unsure how long an avenue was when they walked in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Entered' looks like the action in the surface; it is simply fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A definition by example: many avenues have trees planted along both sides.
